message: My name is Aarav Nair. I was born on 14 March 2002. I weigh 70kg, I'm 175cm tall, and I live in Bangalore.
My goal is to run a sub-2 hour half marathon by next summer.
I don't have any current injuries, but my right knee acts up sometimes.
I typically train 4 days a week, and I'm an intermediate runner. I'd like a coach who keeps me accountable.
